middleweight.src: q1call (29-Jul-2026); q1ppt (~85% of mid-size, Q1FY27, SIAM; 9.1% of Indian motorcycles AMJ'26)

gst.reAction: Passed the full cut on 350cc models (up to Rs22,000); raised prices of 440/450/650cc models. >350cc wholesales -6% YoY in Nov-2025; back to pre-GST levels by Jul-2026 (Guerrilla ~2,500/month, 650 twins ~4,000-4,200/month).

rareEarth.what: China's export curbs on rare-earth magnets disrupted Himalayan, Scram and Guerrilla 450 production in Q1FY26; output stabilised with alternative materials; Bajaj delayed an entry-level Chetak EV. Flying Flea launched Apr-2026, roughly the timing planned in 2025 ('towards the end of FY26').

ev.price: Rs2.79 lakh (Rs1.99 lakh with battery-as-a-service), ex-showroom
ev.plan: one Bengaluru store, then 10 touchpoints, then ~6 cities one by one; S6 scrambler next

commodities.what: 2026 input inflation (aluminium, steel, copper, precious metals, crude) after the West Asia conflict; LPG shortages and election-related labour shortages in Apr-May 2026; RE's net hit 4-4.5% of cost in Q1FY27, 'softening' by late July.

excluded.BAJAJ-AUTO: Earnings distorted: the Mar-2026 quarter carries ~Rs1,894 cr of other income (vs Rs360-690 cr in other quarters) when Bajaj took control of KTM, and KTM is consolidated from that quarter, so its trailing P/E on 30-Sep-2026 sits on an inflated TTM EPS.
excluded.ESCORTS: Earnings distorted: a Rs1,085 cr exceptional gain on selling the railway-equipment business (Jun-2025 quarter) depressed its trailing P/E series for four quarters, and the company that remains (tractors and construction equipment) is not the one in its five-year median.

notes.M&M: Standalone; TTM carries ~Rs470 cr of exceptional impairment charges, which flatters its P/E slightly (makes the de-rating look smaller). Kept.
notes.ASHOKLEY: Consolidated (includes Hinduja Leyland Finance); kept. Also the proxy for VECV's multiple.

moat: Brand
Strong
~85% of India's mid-size (250-750cc) motorcycles (Q1FY27, SIAM); top-of-mind awareness 56% vs 17% for the next brand; 'third-strongest automobile brand' (Brand Finance 2026); 1 in 3 buyers under 25
Lets RE take price (0.85% in Jan, 1.75% in Apr-2026) and sell a 125-year-old design to first-time buyers
Scale on one platform
Strong
The four J-platform 350s were ~92% of domestic volume in Q1FY27; RE EBITDA margin 24-26% against ~14% at Hero and ~12% at TVS
The cost of a new entrant matching RE's 350cc price-feature mix is high
Distribution, service and community
Strong
#1 in the FADA dealer satisfaction survey (2025); ~9 lakh service job cards a month; accessories bought by 87% of buyers; One Ride, Himalayan Odyssey, Motoverse
Allied revenue (15% of sales) and repeat visits that competitors' young networks lack
Pricing power above 350cc
Weak
When GST on >350cc rose from 31% to 40% (Sep-2025) the 440/450/650 range fell (-6% in Nov-2025, -23% in Jun-2026 YoY dispatches) and only got back to pre-GST levels by Jul-2026
The premium end is price-elastic; mix upgrade is not a given
Competitive threat in 350-450cc
Rising
In Jun-2026 RE had ~82% of 350-450cc dispatches; Honda CB350 +62%, Triumph 350 4,692, Jawa-Yezdi-BSA 4,515, Harley X440 1,197 a month
Share is high and slowly eroding at the edges; no rival has scale yet
International
Developing
8-9% of a 0.8-1.0 mn global middleweight market; exports -9% in Apr-Aug 2026; Brazil #2 in middleweight, CKD in 6 countries
Optionality, not a moat; tariffs and weak Europe cap it for now
Electric
Unproven
Flying Flea C6 in one city, 100+ deliveries by July 2026; rare-earth magnet risk (2025)
If the EV transition reaches premium motorcycles, RE's engine-and-sound brand advantage is not guaranteed to carry over
VECV
Moderate
#1 in light and medium trucks (34.9% in FY26), #3 in HD trucks (9.1%) and buses; Volvo technology; but 54.4% under joint control and cyclical
A good CV franchise worth ~10% of our SOTP; not a reason to own the stock
critiques: Management now prefers volume to margin: RE standalone margins are ~150bp below the FY24 peak and likely to stay under pressure (upgrades at little extra price, heavier advertising, the 125th-year campaign)
The export run-rate has been stuck at ~10k a month for a year (US tariffs, Mexico, weak Europe); the outlook is uncertain
Motilal Oswal, Jul-2026; JM Financial (Reduce), May-2026
FY27 is 'a year of two halves': the GST cut lifted demand from Sep-2025, so from Sep-2026 RE laps a high base
Upside is capped by ~13% domestic volume growth and the multiple
Commodity inflation of 4-4.5% cut gross margin 270bp in Q1FY27; no guidance on the rest of the year
The >350cc range (Super Meteor, Himalayan, Shotgun) is still weak after the 40% GST rate
VECV's value is ignored by the market; no plan to list it
Bull case: premiumisation is structural, capacity goes to 2.45 mn, exports recover, VECV is strong: 'premium multiples are justified'
